verdict.rationale: Calendly clearly supports multiple event types. It ships pre-built one-on-one, multi-host and group types, an event-type creation endpoint, per-event-type availability, and buffers and daily limits. However, durations are only implied by a '30-minute meeting' example, per-event locations and custom invitee questions are not documented (only routing-form screening is), and a community report says Calendly refused to add manual booking confirmation. missing for 10: documented per-event duration and location settings, per-event custom booking questions, any confirmation/approval rules (community reports this is absent), independent hands-on corroboration.
